newsitem.title: UK: NatWest, Panmure repeat "buy" on StanChart.
newsitem.headline: NatWest, Panmure repeat "buy" on StanChart.

text.p: Shares in Asian specialist bank Standard Chartered advanced on Monday as NatWest Securities and Panmure Gordon repeated "buy" advice on the shares.
The shares were 8-1/2p higher at 690-1/2p by 1059 GMT, in trade of 2.1 million shares.
David Poutney, banking analyst at Panmure Gordon said his target price for the stock is 8.00 stg, which is a ten percent premium to the sector.
"It has been lagging the sector and last week came off three percent for no particular reason other than there appeared to be one last seller around," he said.
Elsewhere, analysts at NatWest Securities maintained their "buy" stance on the shares despite cutting profit forecasts on currency factors.

NatWest cut their 1997 pretax profit forecast for the banking group by four percent and reduced expectations for the following year by six percent. Market sources cited the recent strength of sterling for the move.
